turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, and you entered a zero on my son's essay before anyone called me. Who decided that, and when?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Don't manage me. I asked you a question: who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
Save it, Hale. The principal is my next stop if you can't answer a simple question. What do you have besides a machine's opinion?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No deal. Nothing about my son stays between us; it goes in writing, and I'm writing down that you asked. Who decided on the zero?
